test_title: PYST 40: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: If A × B means that A is the father of B, A - B means that A is the mother of B, A + B means that A is the brother of B then which of the following expression shows that Q is the son of P?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
+

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

So,

 
• Option - (1) : P × Q + R → P is the father of Q who is the brother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66c29499ec9c770578961567e3bd6b6ffb49213afe8f90134b4c3bf71f5c7a1a.png] 

**Here, Q is the son of P.**

 
• Option - (2) : Q × P + R → Q is the father of P who is the brother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2c4449ac9d7a0d9630bf425f96b076fdc788a2e7880d0f6a3f9bb147126fc3f.png] 

Here, Q is the father of P.

 
• Option - (3) : P + R × Q → P is the brother of Q who is the father of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/967c0cb2f17f52fcd61e40333ef57d5803d9c2d226a7ffa753eed0ecb240a660.png] 

Here, Q is the brother of P.

 
• Option - (4) : P × Q - R → P is the father of Q who is the mother of R.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e84fb2c1349ebbced8a0b5eb6179d8613b687e7f846e850b72feeaa219c2d3f.png] 

Here, Q is the daughter of P.

Hence, "Option - (1)" is the correct answer.
